text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so the URA Finale comes to a close
as a
great success.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Elation! Jubilation! My heart is full of
emotion!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume sprinting towards the
crown with
all their strength! The trainers
watching over them
proudly from the
sidelines!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And through it all, the cheering of the
crowd!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Resplendent! This is the true brilliance
of
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Behold, Trainer
<username>!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
See how the Umamusume work tirelessly
toward
the next shining stage with hope
in their hearts!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This is the scene I dreamed of! This is my
ideal
realized!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Once again... Thank you! This would
never have
come into being without you.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However... This is far from the end.
Indeed, it's
only the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finale is only one stage upon
which our
beloved Umamusume may
shine!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice! The possibilities of Umamusume
are
endless!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I suppose that means we have
many busy
days ahead of us... Isn't that
right, Director?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can rely on your continued
support of this
school and its
Umamusume, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa's passionate speech
stirs me to
my core, and I can't help but
feel proud.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly emotional. It's a privilege to
have met a
trainer like you.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, onwards! Our work is far from
done!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
There can never be too many stages for

Umamusume to shine upon!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can count on you to support the

Umamusume who will lead the future,
Trainer!
